A '''duel''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On Felucia, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] engaged [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], and the pair fought a fierce [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] using their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The duel on Felucia was mentioned in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" />
